rows.grounds: numeral referring to the eight powers
conjunction adding to the preceding list
fused form of siddhisaṃprāptiḥ and mūlakaulaṃ; attainment of powers identified with the root Kaula

items.question: What elements are identified as constituting the root Kaula?
premises: The eight powers are included in this enumeration.
The attainment of powers is included in this enumeration.
These elements are identified as the root Kaula.
items.inference: The root Kaula consists of the eight powers together with the attainment of powers.
uncertainties: The exact referent of the eight is implied from context rather than stated explicitly in this verse.
items.plain_english: And the eight, and the attainment of powers—this is the root Kaula, O fair-faced one.
